sources.title: The Bashar Library Project
sources.notes: Indexed text reviewed. Describes digitization, restoration, transcription, and cataloging of material since 1983. Not a verification of ET identity.

sources.notes: Full page reviewed. Says spoken since 1984, conflicting with the current biography's explicit public-start date of 1983. Do not silently reconcile.

sources.title: The Follow Your Excitement Formula
sources.notes: Full page reviewed. Five current steps and a 2024 book update. Metaphysical/self-help claims, not physical laws established by this source.

sources.title: Bashar's Basic Principles
sources.notes: Full page reviewed. Consciousness, free will, beliefs, and simultaneous time presented as teachings.

sources.title: Seven Sequential Steps of Manifestation
sources.notes: Indexed page reviewed. Introduces material as an August 1995 session; date belongs to the claimed session, not webpage publication.

sources.title: The Formula (handout)
sources.notes: Indexed PDF text reviewed. Three-part formulation; 2015 is copyright year, not a proven first teaching date.

sources.title: Essassani Contact Crystal
sources.notes: Product text reviewed. Calls Bashar a contact specialist and Essassani his world; describes a crystal and meditation as contact aids. Marketing evidence, not effectiveness evidence.

sources.title: Interstellar Enneagram Part 2

sources.title: 2027 The Year Everything Changes
sources.notes: Catalog description reviewed, not full recording. Release is May 2025; describes an arrival forecast for 2027 as current probabilities. Listed questions mention Pleiadians, Yahyel and hybrids, but questions alone cannot establish the answers.

sources.title: May 2025 Live Stream + Recording
sources.notes: Indexed event listing reviewed. Advertises May 24, 11am PDT live session and May 25 recording availability; year grounded in May 2025 bundle title.

profiles.name: Darryl Anka / Bashar
profiles.classification: Claimed extraterrestrial contact specialist; Essassani hybrid civilization in the teaching's cosmology
profiles.origin: Essassani, described by the publisher as Bashar's home world; a parallel future in the broader narrative
profiles.dateBasis: Anka's biography explicitly says public channeling since 1983; the legacy history page instead says 1984.
profiles.summary: Anka presents Bashar through spoken channeling, public Q&A, recorded sessions and private appointments. He describes two 1973 UFO sightings and a channeling class ten years later as precursors. His own account allows a psychological interpretation and says he cannot prove Bashar exists.
claims: The publisher identifies Essassani as Bashar's world and describes him as a contact specialist.
The catalog calls Essassani and Shalinaya hybrid civilizations and places them in a wider named ET cosmology.
A May 2025 session promotes 2027 extraterrestrial arrival as a probability-based forecast, not an observed event.
The basic-principles page treats consciousness as fundamental and beliefs as shaping experience.
caveats: Publications establish that these claims were made; they do not establish an extraterrestrial source.
The psychological usefulness of advice and the factual accuracy of ET or physics claims require different evidence.
As of the research cutoff, 2027 is future; no fulfillment judgment is made.
Video catalog descriptions and YouTube metadata were reviewed, not complete recordings or transcripts.
Private-session policy excludes health/medicine, predictions, politics and free-energy construction topics.

events.title: Anka's reported UFO sightings

findings: Strongest dating finding: current first-person biography says public channeling in 1983, but legacy official history says 1984. Preserve both rather than inventing a private/public distinction.
The catalog is a useful primary source for what the teaching includes, but its release timestamps can differ from session-year categories. Epsilon lists June 2024 release and 2017 Sessions.
Anka's own biography explicitly acknowledges that he cannot prove Bashar's existence and accepts an own-consciousness interpretation. This should be visible in the profile.

The May 2025 event provides a pinned 2027 forecast source. It remains future at the 2026-10-22 cutoff; Reddit allegations of earlier failed forecasts were not adopted without the original dated recordings.

Named species/entity categories here describe Bashar's narrative. They are not established zoological taxa, independently verified civilizations or automatically equivalent to same-name entities in other channelers' accounts.
A Ra-to-Bashar influence relationship was not established by the reviewed sources. Chronological sequence alone is insufficient to draw an influence edge.
Source summaries are concise paraphrases; no extended quotations or paid session content reproduced. Video access level is explicit.
